claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings are NECESSARY and SUFFICIENT for two non-jurist-preference views at characterized scales: (1) Citation Heritage Recovery -- center_projected_64dim AUC 0.77-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74 at 137k-158k decisions (21-24yr); (2) Section Cross-lingual -- Sachverhalt (0.282 > 0.2) > Dispositiv (0.150 > 0.1) hierarchy confirmed at 1K sample scale, Erwaegungen FAILS (0.094 < 0.1), full corpus BLOCKED pending section extraction at 174k; (3) Linear Hybrid Complement -- PASS adversarial gates at 19yr+ (w=0.3-0.4) but JP remains BELOW TF-IDF baseline (0.61-0.67 vs 0.78-0.79). TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY (JP 0.78); Dense = COMPLEMENTARY. Two-mode tradeoff fundamental at all scales. True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. Legal TF-IDF from bge_ corpus FAILS (6-8/14 PASS). v18 coarse hierarchy FAILS (purity 0.65 < 0.7). Data blockers: bge_/bger_ ID mapping, parquet 2024-2026 (15,536 decisions), section extraction at 174k.
evidence_summary: Verified 12 evidence sources independently: (1) citation_heritage_24year_latest.json -- 730 positive pairs, cp_64 AUC 0.7667 PASS; (2) section_crosslingual_eval_latest.json -- Sachverhalt 0.282, Dispositiv 0.150, Erwaegungen 0.094; (3) weight_sweep_22year_latest.json -- hybrids w=0.3-0.4 PASS both adversarial gates, JP 0.61-0.67 < TF-IDF 0.78-0.79; (4) scale_characterization_results.json -- 12k scale shows cross-lingual inflation at 1K (0.656), legal area purity degrades 0.61->0.47; (5) legal_tfidf_bge/all_experiments_results.json -- legal-only variants FAIL citation heritage (AUC ~0.5), branch kNN (0.26-0.39), multilingual invariance; (6) progress.json -- corrected failed_years to [2024,2025,2026], note confirms 2022-2023 valid; (7) complementary_role_characterization_v34.json -- minimal scales characterized; (8) evaluation_22year_center_projected -- dense jurist gate FAIL at all scales (JP 0.05-0.43); (9) v8 holdout -- true OOS ceiling ~0.53; (10) linear_combinations_19year -- first PASS at 19yr/122k; (11) 165k_formal_suite -- dense FAILS jurist gate at 165k (JP 0.39-0.42); (12) v18_coarse_hierarchy -- best purity 0.65 < 0.7. All negative results (Erwaegungen FAIL, dense jurist gate FAIL, legal_tfidf_bge FAIL, v18 FAIL, raw 768-dim FAIL at 24yr, cross-lang retrieval FAIL, boilerplate resistance negative, hierarchy coherence FAIL) honestly reported.
